content: enthec/webappanalyzer (GitHub, GPL-3.0) is the actively maintained community fork of Wappalyzer's technologies.json fingerprint dataset (headers/html/meta/scriptSrc/cookies/dom/js/implies schema), continuing after the 2023 paywall. No official npm package; consumed as raw JSON data by third-party engines. GPL-3.0 licensing applies to the data file itself, a consideration for commercial reuse.
